summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests yttrium-90 labeled anti-CD25 antibody combined with BEAM chemotherapy before stem cell transplant in adults with Hodgkin lymphoma that is refractory or has relapsed. The antibody is given by IV on day -14, and chemotherapy (carmustine, etoposide, cytarabine, and melphalan) is given from day -6 to day -1. Stem cells are infused on day 0, and G-CSF is given from day 5 until neutrophil recovery or as the treating physician judges. The main outcome is not stated in the record; the study is listed as Phase 2.

El anticuerpo se administra por vía intravenosa el día -14, y la quimioterapia (carmustina, etopósido, citarabina y melfalán) se administra del día -6 al día -1. Las células madre se infunden el día 0, y el G-CSF se administra desde el día 5 hasta la recuperación de neutrófilos o según el criterio del médico tratante. El resultado principal no se indica en el registro; el estudio aparece como fase 2.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with Karnofsky performance status of 70% or higher and life expectancy of at least 6 months.
Histologically confirmed Hodgkin lymphoma that is high-risk relapsed or refractory, such as primary refractory disease or relapse within 1 year of frontline the
Not in complete remission at the time of transplant, or relapse after PD-1 blockade or brentuximab vedotin as initial therapy.
At least 2.0 x 10^6 CD34 cells/kg of own stem cells collected by apheresis before enrollment.
Adequate kidney, liver, heart, and lung function, and agreement to use effective birth control during the study.
not_for: Planned brentuximab vedotin consolidation after transplant.
Prior high-dose chemotherapy with autologous stem cell transplant, or prior allogeneic transplant.
Active cancer other than Hodgkin lymphoma, or myelodysplasia.
Active hepatitis B or C, or hepatitis B surface antigen positive; HIV-positive unless criteria are met.
Pregnancy or breastfeeding, or lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma.
